snippets.description: Two Action with constructor DI: simple (one dependency, DB::transaction, Command DTO) and medium (StateMachine + StoreRepository, business validation via ValidationException)
PersistenceService — orchestration of three dependencies (store-repo + sync-service + attachment-repo); SyncService — delegation to repository, domain event, broadcaster
Composite Action: multi-step script via atomic composition Actions in one external transaction (instead use-case Service)
Slim controller: authorize → FormRequest → mapper → Action → redirect/Inertia; method injection Action to action method vs constructor injection
When an interface is needed: contract + bind according to the config, singleton, contextual binding - with comment «is NOT needed by default, concrete classes are resolved zero-config»
Matrix of allowed injections by layers + antipatterns: app() in Action, injection Request, cycles, god-constructor 6+, interface without second implementation
